glossary.note: 钢铁雄心4 术语对照表。翻译时严格遵守，保证全站译名一致。

style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

units.en: The AI will attempt to reform the Austro-Hungarian Empire by rebuilding their military and demanding subjugation of the countries that now occupy their old lands.
The AI will attempt to reform the Austrian Empire by rebuilding their military and then expanding and annexing their old lost territories.
The AI will attempt to form the Danubian Federation by inviting other nations along the Danube under a non-aligned rule.
The AI will attempt to go communist and overthrow the government before aligning with the USSR and joining the Comintern
The AI will attempt to go communist and overthrow the government. Adhering to a strict Austromarxist agenda they will create a faction of their own
The AI will attempt to form the Danubian Federation by inviting other nations along the Danube under a democratic rule.
The AI will attempt to join the Allies by re-establishing democracy in Austria.
The AI will attempt to re-establish democracy in Austria and form the Alpine Federation.

The AI will largely follow the Historical path, but will attempt to stave of Anschluss by any means possible, fighting tooth and claw for their independence until the bitter end. This might present a challenge or delay to the outbreak of the war
Belgium will initially try to stave off attacks, but will then fall back to the Congo and continue the war from there.
The AI will go with the Rexist Fascists, and establish a tall highly industrial state, then assist the fascists in the war.
The AI will go with the Flemish Nationalist Fascists, and aggressively try to unite the low countries then turn on France.
The AI will throw off the shackles of their weak-willed king, and attempt to defend Belgium at all costs.
The AI will allow the Labour party to win the election, and then slowly begin to align themselves with the Communist bloc.
The Congolese AI will stay with Belgium and utilize its relationship with the nation to its fullest potential, eventually looking for increased autonomy
The Congolese AI will attempt to gain it's independence as soon as it can through peaceful means, and later campaign for democracy throughout Africa.
The Congolese AI will attempt to gain it's independence as soon as it can through peaceful means, and later attempt to spread communism throughout Africa.

The Congolese AI will attempt to break free from their colonial overlords through a violent revolution and subsequent civil war, and will then attempt to spread communism throughout the African continent.
The Afghan AI will attempt to stay neutral throughout the time period while also attempting to gain economic concessions from the Allies, Comintern and Axis powers.

The Afghan AI will attempt to oust King Zahir Shah and replace him with Amanullah Khan who will then attempt to rapidly modernize the country. Afghanistan will then look to expanding its borders with the aid of the Axis powers.
The Afghan AI will push King Zahir Shah to oust his uncles before continuing on a path of radical reforms. This will culminate in Afghanistan becoming a democracy and joining the Allies.

The Afghan AI will cozy up to the Soviet Union and implement radical reforms to transform the nation into a Communist state. It will then join the Comintern and attempt to take control of central Asia.

The Afghan AI will attempt to oust King Zahir Shah and replace him with the Faqir of Ipi who will then attempt to reverse the modernization of the country. Afghanistan will then look to expanding its borders eventually forming a new Caliphate.

The Afghan AI will attempt to oust King Zahir Shah and replace him with Emir Sayyid Mir Muhammad Alim Khan who will then attempt to unify the Afghan tribes. Afghanistan will then look to expanding its borders eventually forming a new Afghan Empire.

The Afghan AI will attempt to oust King Zahir Shah and replace him with Mirza Khurshid Jah Bahadur who will then attempt to recreate the Mughal Empire. They will then look to expanding their borders eventually forming a new Timurid Empire.
The AI will flip-flop between historical coups, culminating in the Golden Square seizing control and going to war with the UK before ultimately restoring the monarchy and surrendering.
The AI will attempt to put the Golden Square in power as soon as possible before joining the Axis to fight the UK. They will then attempt to annex neighbouring Arab territories.
The AI will attempt to remain loyal to the UK while building up its power in the region, gradually taking over administration of territory and ultimately forming the Hashemite Arab Federation.
Bakr Sidqi will launch his historical coup but will not be assassinated. Instead, the government will work with Iran and Turkey to form a regional power bloc.
The Kurds of Northern Iraq will launch a revolt against the Iraqi government. If they succeed, they will attempt to unify their lands across Turkey and Iran.
The AI will work through political reforms and bolster their military, before being invaded and immediately capitulating.
The AI will establish an absolute monarchy as Reza Shah Pahlavi and work towards a campaign of conquest in the Middle East.
The AI will force constitutional limits on the Shah and follow a path of democracy before eventually attempting to join a democratic faction.
The AI will engage in a revolution that will leave the Soviet aligned Tudeh party in power. The communist regime will attempt to destabilize the region.
The AI will unite the country's nationalists and form SUMKA, bringing a fascist regime to the country. It will attempt to join a fascist faction and declare war on their neighbors.
The Philippines will remain aligned with the United States
The Philippines will play the USA and the Japanese off against each other, to maximize their potential.
The Philippines will align themselves with the Japanese, potentially falling foul of fascism themselves.
The Philippines will have its election overturned, having Partido Sakdalista take over until eventually having an independence war with support from friendly Hispanic nations and becoming a monarchy.
The red sun will rise over the Philippines, as maritime communism takes hold and seeks to spread the spirit of equality across the world's oceans.
After the fall of the Philippine government, a military figure will rise and lead the nation against any and all aggressors.
The world is colonized as historical.

Puppets give a part of their Peace Score to their Overlord. The ratio depends on their Autonomy.
Puppets keep all the Peace Score they earned during the war.
Faction Members keep all the Peace Score they earned during the war.
Faction Members give 10% of their Peace Score to the Faction Leader.
All winners keep all the Peace Score they earned during the war.
Winners with less than 5% of war participation give all their score to other winners. Does not apply if no winner has at least 10% of war participation. Does not apply to Human Players.
